purpose: Prospectively test returned semantic-trace query usefulness without allowing relevance gains to hide external-center diversity or query-length regressions.
matched_conditions: candidate frozen before baseline and candidate episode-2 return
no candidate access to either episode-2 return
strict_gain_requirement: At least one nonregression dimension must improve strictly, with candidate external_center_count >= 2.
decision_rule: PASS_BOUNDED_RELATION_TRACE_QUERY_V2 only under Pareto non-regression across coverage, mean relevance, external-center diversity, and query length plus at least one strict gain; otherwise WITHHOLD_V2_NONREGRESSION_OR_GAIN_NOT_MET.

burden_scope.B1_ABSTRACTION: unchanged prerequisite: bounded nuisance-invariance + relevant perturbation sensitivity
burden_scope.B2_CAUSAL_USE: future-only Pareto returned comparison under matched episode-2 World returns
burden_scope.B3_INTERNALIZATION: still closed; requires state semantic ownership, capability-specific scaffold source removal, restart/delayed reuse, fresh disjoint transfer, and independent/evaluator-hidden return

claim_fence: A future v2 pass establishes only bounded Pareto-nonregressing query usefulness against the matched lexical baseline. It does not retroactively alter v1 results or establish general semantics, truth, AGI, consciousness, or Internalizer admission.
